title: Everything Bagel Hard-Boiled Eggs
description: Hard-boiled eggs halved and sprinkled with everything bagel seasoning for a 2-minute high-protein snack.
steps: Boil the eggs 9-10 minutes, then cool in ice water and peel.
Halve the eggs and season generously with the bagel seasoning.
Store in the fridge for up to 4 days.
notes: Keep a batch of boiled eggs ready in the fridge at all times — this is the fastest protein snack there is.
